_comment: Who settles for whom at the central bank, and where VouchMorph's fees are paid. Mobile-money issuers are not central bank members: their sponsor bank settles for them.
_fee_source: LEDGER: fee shares are paid from fee_ledger (Section 23 Rev. 2) - VouchMorph's levy and 35% on the fee line, the destination's shares on its principal line; legacy FEE_INVOICE rows are no longer advised. INVOICE: the old whole-fee invoices.
_advise_from: Only swaps, invoices and fee shares created on or after this moment go on settlement advices. The backlog before it (488 open settlements from 5 Aug - 20 Sep, including the oversized test swaps) waits for the accountant's clean-up; move this date back to release it.
